parts.text: I work as a dispatcher at one of the drone operating companies. My job is to plan and run the flights, and I am the licensed person responsible for each flight who decides which drone flies along which way and signs it off before it leaves. I plan and run things alongside several other dispatchers, often for the same busy sites and popular drones at the same time. I don't know the details of a full daily schedule from arrival to leaving, as my notes do not describe that routine.
